title: soothfast runner record
description: One line of a bench binary's `--json` output, which `measure` and `gate` collect. The stream is JSON Lines on stdout: a line not starting with `{` is ignored, but a line starting with `{` that is not valid JSON fails the run. Readers ignore a record whose `type` they do not know and ignore unknown keys in every record, so only the keys listed under `required` below are needed. Discovery runs (`--list --json`, `--list-routes --json`) emit `item` and `route` records the same way.

oneOf.description: First line of a run: what this host can measure and which backend gates.

perfcnt.description: Whether hardware performance counters are usable.

item_reuse.description: Whether the binary supports per-item reuse of stored measurements. Absent reads as false.

guest_cpu.description: Callgrind only: digest of the CPU the guest sees. The four `guest_*`/`valgrind` keys count only when all are present.

guest_libc.description: Callgrind only: digest of the loaded libc file.

callgrind_method.description: Callgrind only: how `ir` is taken (`one-process` or `two-process`). Counts from different methods are never compared. Absent reads as `two-process`.

group.description: Group named by `group = ...`; ignored by readers.

fingerprint.description: Hex FNV-1a fingerprint of the item's token stream, as a string.

covers.description: Public item the benchmark covers; empty when unset.

oneOf.description: Walltime noise floor measured before the items run.
One backend's measurement of one item. An item has one `result` per backend. A tool that measures differently emits the same shape with the backend that matches its metrics.

id.description: Item id. A record without it is skipped.

fingerprint.description: Hex fingerprint of the item; empty when unknown.

covers.description: Public item the benchmark covers; empty when unset.

tolerance_pct.description: Per-item gate threshold override in percent.

backend.description: `walltime`, `perfcnt`, `callgrind`, `alloc`, `asyncexec` or `buildcost`. Any other value is ignored.

metrics.description: Metrics of that backend. Counts are non-negative JSON integers; a float such as 3.0 does not read as one. Each backend reads only its own keys.

median_ns.description: walltime: median iteration time in nanoseconds.

mad_ns.description: walltime: median absolute deviation in nanoseconds.

min_ns.description: walltime: fastest sample in nanoseconds; ignored by readers.

max_ns.description: walltime: slowest sample in nanoseconds; ignored by readers.

window.description: callgrind: iterations `ir` averages over. Read only to explain a difference between two sides.

build_ms.description: buildcost: build time in milliseconds. Readers accept it here; the runner itself never emits it.

size_bytes.description: buildcost: artifact size in bytes. Readers accept it here; the runner itself never emits it.

oneOf.description: Functions an item executed, as `[object, symbol]` pairs. Read only when the env record's `gating_backend` is `callgrind`; used to decide whether a stored measurement still applies.

id.description: Item id. A record without it is skipped.

functions.description: Executed functions. An element that is not a pair of strings is skipped.

oneOf.description: Verdict of one checked claim on an item. Any failing assertion fails the run.

ok.description: Whether the claim held; absent reads as false.

oneOf.description: Raw data behind a `complexity` claim. Emitted by the runner for diagnostics; readers ignore it.

claimed.description: Claimed complexity class, for example `n log n`.

drift.description: Growth drift against the claimed class.

ok.description: Whether the drift is within the limit.

oneOf.description: A `#[route]` registration, from `--list-routes --json`. Every key except `type` defaults to empty or absent when missing.

spec.description: Spec file, relative to the package.

operation.description: Operation id or name in the spec.

params.description: Query parameter type override, or null.

path_params.description: Path parameter type override, or null.
